About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

A global digital transformation organization that helps leading enterprises reimagine how they create, manage, and deliver customer experiences by combining technology, creativity, AI, and engineering. Through multidisciplinary teams and hands-on execution, we partner with organizations to modernize workflows, scale content operations, accelerate innovation, and build solutions that drive measurable business impact.


Job Summary

We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to work at the core of content and creative transformation engagements.

In this role, you will map existing creative workflows, redesign them, and build AI-powered pipelines that demonstrate a new operating model inside real production environments.

Building is not a differentiator in this role - it is the job. The ideal candidate comes from creative technology, production engineering, content operations, or applied AI within creative environments. You operate inside workflows, not above them.

Depending on the engagement, you may operate in a forward-deployed capacity, embedded directly within client teams and working alongside creative directors, producers, marketing technology leads, content operations teams, and engineers to redesign and ship workflows in real time.

This is not a separate program or specialization. It is an expected mode of working, requiring adaptability, hands-on execution, and close collaboration with stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Workflow Mapping & Redesign

  • Map creative workflows end-to-end, including briefing, concepting, production, review, localization, activation, and measurement.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for automation.

  • Diagnose root causes of workflow friction, including approval delays, handoff failures, tooling gaps, and governance challenges.

  • Design future-state workflows that effectively balance AI automation and human oversight.

AI Pipeline Development

This is the core responsibility of the role.

  • Configure and implement creative AI platforms and tools against real production requirements.

  • Integrate AI-powered workflows into existing ecosystems, including DAMs, CMS platforms, marketing technology stacks, and project management systems.

  • Build prompt architectures, agent workflows, automation layers, and quality control mechanisms that can operate reliably at production scale.

  • Develop working proofs of concept and production-ready solutions that demonstrate measurable business value.

  • Rapidly iterate and deploy solutions within the constraints of active client engagements.

Governance & Adoption

  • Establish governance frameworks covering brand safety, content rights management, model selection, approval workflows, compliance, and auditability.

  • Train and enable teams to successfully adopt new workflows and technologies.

  • Define and track success metrics, including throughput, cycle time, cost-per-asset, quality consistency, and operational efficiency.

  • Ensure knowledge transfer and long-term sustainability beyond the initial engagement.

Engagement Support & Practice Development

  • Contribute to project scoping and solution design across content operations, creative production, AI transformation, and marketing technology initiatives.

  • Develop reusable accelerators, templates, tooling configurations, and best practices.

  • Help evolve internal methodologies and delivery frameworks for future engagements.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in creative technology, content operations, production engineering, marketing technology, automation, or applied AI.

  • Demonstrated track record of shipping production-ready solutions with measurable business outcomes.

  • Experience working across both creative and technical stakeholder groups.

  • Proven ability to translate operational challenges into scalable workflow solutions.

Builder Capability (Required)

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying creative, content, or marketing workflow solutions.

  • Experience configuring and implementing creative AI tools and automation platforms in real-world environments.

  • Working knowledge of DAM systems, CMS platforms, content APIs, project management tools, and orchestration frameworks.

  • Strong understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agents, and workflow automation.

  • Ability to independently create and deploy proofs of concept that drive stakeholder alignment and adoption.

Creative Domain Expertise

  • Deep understanding of creative production processes, content supply chains, and asset lifecycle management.

  • Familiarity with enterprise creative ecosystems, including tools such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Workfront, Adobe Firefly, Figma, and related platforms.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with creative directors, producers, brand operations teams, content strategists, and marketing technology stakeholders.

Mindset

  • Strong bias toward execution and delivery.

  • Diagnostic and systems-thinking approach to problem solving.

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and taking ownership of outcomes.

  • Able to work independently while collaborating effectively across functions.

  • Focused on practical solutions that create measurable impact.

  • Most effective working directly within operational environments rather than from a purely advisory position.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with enterprise content supply chain transformation initiatives.

  • Familiarity with creative AI platforms, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.

  • Exposure to Adobe ecosystem products, including Firefly Services, GenStudio, AEM, and Workfront.

  • Experience embedding with client teams in consulting, agency, or enterprise transformation environments.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

  • TEAMSPIRIT & TEAMEVENTS: Freu dich auf eine kollegiale Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien, jede Menge Spaß und großartigem Teamspirit sowie regelmäßige Teamevents wie gemeinsame Sportsessions, Grillabende oder einfach nur ein Feierabenddrink an deiner Station.

  • CAMPER BUDGET: Du bekommst eine jährliche Freimiete für unsere Camper, damit du den #happyroadsurfing Lifestyle selbst erleben kannst.

  • DISCOUNTS UND BENEFITS: Nutze unsere Corporate Benefits Plattform, die Travel Industry Card und Family & Friends Rabatte.

Die Rolle – Deine Leidenschaft

  • Du begeisterst unsere Kund*innen bei der Abholung und Rückgabe ihres Campers mit einem strahlenden Lächeln und gestaltest ihre roadsurfer-Reise unvergesslich.

  • Du erläuterst und übergibst unsere Camper persönlich an die Kund*innen.

  • Du packst tatkräftig mit an und kümmerst dich um die gründliche Reinigung – innen wie außen – unserer Camper.

  • Du unterstützt das Stationsteam bei allen täglichen Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass unsere #happyroadsurfer mit Freude in den Urlaub starten.

Was du brauchst, um mit uns auf einer Welle zu surfen

  • Du bist absolut hands-on und packst jederzeit mit an.

  • Optimalerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung im Kundenservice mit.

  • Führerschein Klasse B.

  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Dein Gehalt

Wir ❤️ Transparenz. Das Gehaltsband für diese Position liegt zwischen 32.000 EUR und 32.400 EUR brutto jährlich. Wir führen aktuell Gehaltsbänder in unseren Stellenbeschreibungen ein, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Sobald wir uns im Bewerbungsprozess besser kennenlernen und deine Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen noch genauer einschätzen können, finden wir gemeinsam heraus, welche Stufe innerhalb des Gehaltsbands am besten zu dir passt. In einem jährlichen Feedbackgespräch wird dein Gehalt mindestens einmal im Jahr überprüft.

Bereit zur surfen?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Für Rückfragen kannst du dich auch gern jederzeit an ----- wenden. Bitte bewirb dich ausschließlich über unser Bewerbertool – so geht nichts verloren und wir können deine Bewerbung schnell bearbeiten.

But that’s only the beginning. We are growing fast, so hop on board and join us on our journey. The roadsurfer philosophy is simple: rent an RV, start your adventure, be happy. Come ride the wave with us!

description: Warum roadsurfer? TEAMSPIRIT & TEAMEVENTS: Freu dich auf eine kollegiale Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien, jede Menge Spaß und großartigem Teamspirit sowie regelmäßige Teamevents wie gemeinsame Sportsessions, Grillabende oder einfach nur ein Feierabenddrink an deiner Station. CAMPER BUDGET: Du bekommst eine jährliche Freimiete für unsere Camper, damit du den #happyroadsurfing Lifestyle selbst erleben kannst. DISCOUNTS UND BENEFITS: Nutze unsere Corporate Benefits Plattform, die Travel Industry Card und Family & Friends Rabatte. DEVELOPMENT & GROWTH: Wachstum spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei roadsurfer! Bei unseren regelmäßigen Station Life Camps und Trainings kannst du dich mit Teammitgliedern aus aller Welt vernetzen und deine Fähigkeiten verbessern – sei es im Bereich Fahrzeugwissen oder Kundenservice – stets begleitet von unseren Learning & Training-Expert:innen. BUDDY PROGRAMM: Zum Start begleitet dich eine erfahrene Person aus einer anderen Station – in der gleichen Position, aber an einem anderen Standort. So hast du direkt eine feste Ansprechperson und lernst den roadsurfer Spirit über deine eigene Station hinaus kennen. Deine Rolle – Deine Leidenschaft Du koordinierst die Abläufe rund um unsere Camper-Vans – von der Vorbereitung bis zur Rückgabe. Du packst bei der Aufbereitung auch selbst mal mit an und unterstützt dein Team tatkräftig. Du übernimmst die fachliche Begleitung, Anleitung und Motivation deiner Teammitglieder. Du bringst dich aktiv in Schulungen und Trainings ein und stärkst so die Weiterentwicklung deines Teams. Du prüfst Rückläufer sorgfältig, dokumentierst Auffälligkeiten, meldest sie an unser HQ in München und kümmerst dich um die weitere Bearbeitung – kleinere Handgriffe erledigst du direkt, für größere Reparaturen koordinierst du Fachpartner. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards jederzeit eingehalten werden. Was du brauchst, um mit uns auf einer Welle zu surfen Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung – idealerweise im Bereich Autovermietung, Tourismus o.ä. Freude am Service und im Umgang mit Menschen – freundlich, offen und kommunikativ. Du packst gerne mit an, wenn es nötig ist, und behältst auch in stressigen Momenten den Überblick. Organisationstalent, Lösungsorientierung und eine positive Einstellung zeichnen dich aus. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse. Führerschein Klasse B. Support the initial assessment of partners through qualitative and quantitative analysis (e.g., partner fit, customer base, integration potential). Engage partners with a clear value proposition and qualify initial interest. Relationship Building & Support: Assist in building and maintaining strong working relationships with partners. Participate in partner calls and meetings, prepare follow-ups, and support ongoing communication. Help deliver value to partners by understanding their needs and coordinating with internal teams. Process & Reporting: Track outreach and pipeline activity in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce). Share regular updates on partner funnel status and help improve outreach playbooks and processes. Collaborate with Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing to ensure partner prospects are well aligned with Moss’ commercial strategy. Relationship— Oriented: You enjoy speaking to people, understand how to build rapport, and communicate with clarity. Self-Starter: You take initiative, manage your own pipeline, and are eager to learn from every interaction. Team Player: You collaborate closely with teammates and internal stakeholders to deliver joint results. Growth-Driven: You’re looking to grow into a Partner Manager role over time and want to learn how to build high-impact commercial partnerships. To date, over 5000 businesses in Germany, Netherlands and the UK use Moss’ leading spend management product, with modules such as corporate cards , accounts payables , employee cash reimbursements and procurement . Moss has raised a total of €180 million in funding and is backed by the most renowned tech investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures and A-Star. Be part of a culture that thrives on impact and speed, where you can take bold moves, learn fast and accomplish more. We’re a place where you can fast track your career - here's what else to expect: Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos. title: VP of Network Engineering
description: 1. ABOUT THE ROLE The global marketplace for bandwidth. Share aggregates telco infrastructure into a single intelligence layer, giving ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a seamless path to deliver connectivity into every home and business. We're hiring a VP of Network Engineering to lead the function that makes this real. This is the senior-most networking role at Share, reporting directly to the founders. You will own the entire technical estate (backbone, aggregation, access, peering, the systems they depend on, and the partner integrations they touch) and the team that builds and runs it. This is a role for someone who wants to create, not just operate. The mandate is to design the protocols, define the standards, and develop the reference architectures that an entire ecosystem of partner ISPs will inherit from us, and to leverage AI across the operational surface so the network behaves more like a system that thinks than a stack of boxes that's been configured. The expectation is still hands-on. You'll set technical direction, run a small high-leverage engineering team, and stay close enough to the metal that you can sit on a BGP debug call at 2am and not be the bottleneck. This is also a deeply partner-facing role: you'll absorb partner ISPs into our platform and push each one past whatever ceiling they walked in with. 2. WHAT YOU'LL OWN The network as a system Design the protocols, standards, and reference architectures that the rest of the ecosystem inherits from us. Partner ISPs across the continent will adopt the patterns you set (peering policy, hand-off contracts, service profiles, security posture) because conforming to Share's baseline is how they unlock the speeds we deliver. This is closer to standards work than to operations management: it ships as configuration, but it lives as doctrine. Make the architectural calls that don't have a textbook answer yet: how a shared physical backbone is sliced across many partner ISPs at multi-tenant scale, how policy is expressed once and enforced everywhere, where the control plane goes next, what we retire, and what we keep. Treat the network as a system that learns. Drive the use of AI in operations: anomaly detection across flow and streaming telemetry, predictive failure analysis on optical and routing layers, automated triage and runbook execution, traffic-engineering and peering decisions informed by models, and config-drift detection across partner hand-offs. You won't build the models from scratch, but you'll set the bar for where AI replaces human reaction time and where it doesn't. The routing and peering core Own the strategy for our BGP edge: IP transit with Workonline, WIOCC, MTN/Bayobab, Afr-IX, and Skytrend, plus public and private peering at KIXP and LINX, and PNIs with the hyperscalers. Own the policy posture: filter chains, route policy, communities, RPKI, and traffic-engineering logic across our border fabric and downstream. Direct MPLS in the backbone (L3VPN and EVPN for partner isolation, services delivery, and multi-tenant scale) and decide where the control plane goes next (LDP vs. SR, address-family strategy). Negotiate and establish new peering arrangements (content, CDN on-nets, cache fills, hyperscaler PNIs) and tune the mix for cost, performance, and resilience. Aggregation, access, and the services plane Own the disaggregated, white-box switching strategy: modern NOS stacks on commodity silicon (SONiC, IP Infusion OcNOS, and similar). You should have a position on vendor lock-in, and you should have already acted on it elsewhere. Direct L2/L3 aggregation (VLANs, MC-LAG/EVPN-VXLAN, QoS, clean L2 hand-offs to partner ISPs) and BNG strategy (PPPoE/IPoE termination, QoS, CGNAT where needed, CoA-driven session control that hooks into our AAA layer). Own passive optical access (GPON, XGS-PON, OLT/ONU strategy, service profile design) and the fiber plant itself: ODF and splice planning, OTDR traces, loss budgets, and dark-fiber troubleshooting across our leased routes (KETRACO, KPC, Systel, and the ADC, iColo, PAIX metro ring). Partner with the Systems team on the AAA stack (FreeRADIUS proxy architecture, per-partner containerized instances, Splynx integrations, CoA relay for payment-driven session control). They own that stack; you own the network-side of every integration, every session-control decision, and every end-to-end accounting flow. Own the network-layer services the AAA plane depends on: NAT/CGNAT, DHCP, IPAM, DNS, IP/ASN planning, IPv6, and dual-stack rollout. The team Hire, develop, and lead the network engineering team, including the junior and senior engineers we'll add as we scale. You set the bar, the culture, and the bench. Build a team that writes things down. Push our source-of-truth (Nautobot) and config automation (Jinja-based generation) forward with the Systems and Dev teams, so the network is driven by data rather than tribal knowledge. Run a team that's allergic to ticket-shuffling and bureaucracy: runbooks, post-mortems, automation, and a real culture of operational discipline. raw.title: VP of Network Engineering
raw.description:
1. ABOUT THE ROLE

The global marketplace for bandwidth. Share aggregates telco infrastructure into a single intelligence layer, giving ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a seamless path to deliver connectivity into every home and business.

We're hiring a VP of Network Engineering to lead the function that makes this real. This is the senior-most networking role at Share, reporting directly to the founders. You will own the entire technical estate (backbone, aggregation, access, peering, the systems they depend on, and the partner integrations they touch) and the team that builds and runs it.

This is a role for someone who wants to create, not just operate. The mandate is to design the protocols, define the standards, and develop the reference architectures that an entire ecosystem of partner ISPs will inherit from us, and to leverage AI across the operational surface so the network behaves more like a system that thinks than a stack of boxes that's been configured.

The expectation is still hands-on. You'll set technical direction, run a small high-leverage engineering team, and stay close enough to the metal that you can sit on a BGP debug call at 2am and not be the bottleneck. This is also a deeply partner-facing role: you'll absorb partner ISPs into our platform and push each one past whatever ceiling they walked in with.


2. WHAT YOU'LL OWN

The network as a system

  • Design the protocols, standards, and reference architectures that the rest of the ecosystem inherits from us. Partner ISPs across the continent will adopt the patterns you set (peering policy, hand-off contracts, service profiles, security posture) because conforming to Share's baseline is how they unlock the speeds we deliver. This is closer to standards work than to operations management: it ships as configuration, but it lives as doctrine.

  • Make the architectural calls that don't have a textbook answer yet: how a shared physical backbone is sliced across many partner ISPs at multi-tenant scale, how policy is expressed once and enforced everywhere, where the control plane goes next, what we retire, and what we keep.

  • Treat the network as a system that learns. Drive the use of AI in operations: anomaly detection across flow and streaming telemetry, predictive failure analysis on optical and routing layers, automated triage and runbook execution, traffic-engineering and peering decisions informed by models, and config-drift detection across partner hand-offs. You won't build the models from scratch, but you'll set the bar for where AI replaces human reaction time and where it doesn't.

The routing and peering core

  • Own the strategy for our BGP edge: IP transit with Workonline, WIOCC, MTN/Bayobab, Afr-IX, and Skytrend, plus public and private peering at KIXP and LINX, and PNIs with the hyperscalers.

  • Own the policy posture: filter chains, route policy, communities, RPKI, and traffic-engineering logic across our border fabric and downstream.

  • Direct MPLS in the backbone (L3VPN and EVPN for partner isolation, services delivery, and multi-tenant scale) and decide where the control plane goes next (LDP vs. SR, address-family strategy).

  • Negotiate and establish new peering arrangements (content, CDN on-nets, cache fills, hyperscaler PNIs) and tune the mix for cost, performance, and resilience.

Aggregation, access, and the services plane

  • Own the disaggregated, white-box switching strategy: modern NOS stacks on commodity silicon (SONiC, IP Infusion OcNOS, and similar). You should have a position on vendor lock-in, and you should have already acted on it elsewhere.

  • Direct L2/L3 aggregation (VLANs, MC-LAG/EVPN-VXLAN, QoS, clean L2 hand-offs to partner ISPs) and BNG strategy (PPPoE/IPoE termination, QoS, CGNAT where needed, CoA-driven session control that hooks into our AAA layer).

  • Own passive optical access (GPON, XGS-PON, OLT/ONU strategy, service profile design) and the fiber plant itself: ODF and splice planning, OTDR traces, loss budgets, and dark-fiber troubleshooting across our leased routes (KETRACO, KPC, Systel, and the ADC, iColo, PAIX metro ring).

  • Partner with the Systems team on the AAA stack (FreeRADIUS proxy architecture, per-partner containerized instances, Splynx integrations, CoA relay for payment-driven session control). They own that stack; you own the network-side of every integration, every session-control decision, and every end-to-end accounting flow.

  • Own the network-layer services the AAA plane depends on: NAT/CGNAT, DHCP, IPAM, DNS, IP/ASN planning, IPv6, and dual-stack rollout.

The team

  • Hire, develop, and lead the network engineering team, including the junior and senior engineers we'll add as we scale. You set the bar, the culture, and the bench.

  • Build a team that writes things down. Push our source-of-truth (Nautobot) and config automation (Jinja-based generation) forward with the Systems and Dev teams, so the network is driven by data rather than tribal knowledge.

  • Run a team that's allergic to ticket-shuffling and bureaucracy: runbooks, post-mortems, automation, and a real culture of operational discipline.

Partner ISPs

  • Lead the technical relationship with our partner ISPs. You'll sit on senior calls with their leadership and engineering teams, walk their networks, and own the technical commitments we make on both sides of the hand-off.

  • Translate between “this is what we need to deliver 100x speeds on your network” and “this is the concrete change on your OLT, your router, or your peering config tomorrow morning.” Every partner shows up with their own vendor mix and habits (MikroTik on RouterOS, Huawei on access, all the variations); the job is to bring each one to our baseline and push them past whatever ceiling they walked in with.

  • Own the technical credibility of Share with partners. When their senior engineer is on the call, you should be the person they want on the other end.

Uptime and the broader platform

  • Own PoP and backbone reliability end-to-end: SLOs, incident response, post-mortems, and the culture around them. Catch degradations before partners do.

  • Sit at the leadership table as the voice of the network. Inform product decisions, capital allocation on capacity, peering strategy, and how we expand geographically.

3. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We care much more about depth, judgment, and ownership than about org-chart titles on a résumé. The right person is a builder who happens to have grown into leadership, not an executive who has drifted away from the work. If you've spent the last few years inside a large telco running PowerPoint reviews two layers removed from the CLI, this isn't your role. If you're still close enough to your network to spot a leaky origin from the symptoms before someone hands you a ticket, keep reading.

Must-have

  • Senior leadership experience inside an ISP, carrier, or comparable network operator: running a team, owning architecture, and answering for uptime. Not enterprise networking, and not a pure-corporate role detached from operations.

  • A real track record of building or leading network engineering teams: hiring, leveling, setting technical direction, and being the person the team escalates to.

  • Deep BGP: route policy, communities, RPKI, route reflection, upstream/peer selection, traffic engineering, and the instincts to debug a leaky origin at 2am, not just direct the people who do.

  • MPLS in production at scale (L3VPN and EVPN), including control-plane details (LDP, SR, BGP address families) and opinions on where the architecture goes next.

  • Real operational experience with passive optical access (GPON or XGS-PON), OLT/ONU provisioning, and service modelling. If you haven't run PON, you've run an access network at comparable scale and understand the protocol stack.

  • Comfortable in disaggregated, white-box environments (SONiC, IP Infusion OcNOS, or similar). You don't need a vendor badge to operate a switch.

About 3E:

3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions. 

You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

Join us and make an impact!

About the Role

3E is seeking a proactive, entrepreneurial Sales Executive to join our Commercial team and drive growth across the DACH region, with a strong focus on Germany, Switzerland, and Austria.

In this high-impact role, you will build and own a self-generated pipeline, pursue new logo opportunities, and develop strong relationships with decision-makers across complex manufacturing environments, including chemical manufacturing, industrial manufacturing, and related enterprise markets.

This role is built for a true hunter: someone energized by outbound prospecting, strategic market mapping, cold outreach, and opening doors in complex B2B sales cycles. You will sell 3E’s full suite of SaaS and regulatory compliance solutions, partnering with internal experts to align our offerings with customer needs and strategic business priorities.

If you are fluent in German, thrive in a self-driven environment, and are passionate about building territory growth from the ground up, this is an opportunity to lead and win in one of 3E’s most important markets.

 

What You'll Do

  • Drive Enterprise Growth: Lead new business sales across our three core product families—Chemical & Workplace Safety, Product Safety & Stewardship, and Supply Chain & Sustainability—targeting large, complex enterprise organizations.

  • Generate and Scale Pipeline: Proactively build and expand a self-generated pipeline by leveraging strategic market mapping, personalized outreach, and your established enterprise network to drive sustained revenue growth.

  • Own the Enterprise Sales Cycle: Manage complex sales cycles end-to-end—from initial discovery to contract closure—partnering with internal subject matter experts to deliver value-driven solutions, cross-sell across product lines, and exceed ambitious revenue targets.

  • Engage, Expand, and Elevate Relationships: Initiate and lead high-impact conversations with C-level executives and key decision-makers, aligning 3E’s innovative solutions with their strategic business goals to create long-term, high-value partnerships.

  • Master Consultative Selling: Work closely with our industry experts to craft tailored proposals, manage product trials, and ensure solution alignment with client needs, positioning 3E as a trusted advisor in a rapidly evolving market.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Fluency in German is required; native or near-native German language skills are strongly preferred.

  • 5+ years of successful B2B sales experience, ideally selling complex SaaS, inormation services, regulatory compliance, EHS, supply chain, sustainability, or related enterprise solutions.

  • Proven success as an individual contributor with a strong record of meeting or exceeding quota.

  • Experience closing five- to six-figure deals using a consultative selling approach.

  • Demonstrated hunter mindset with the ability to self-source, develop, and close new business opportunities.

  • Experience selling into complex organizations with multiple stakeholders and longer sales cycles.

  • Strong territory management skills, with the ability to prioritize high-value opportunities across a large addressable market.

  • Confidence working remotely as a self-starter, with the maturity and discipline to manage your own activity, pipeline, and results.

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills with customers, partners, and internal teams.

  • Experience using Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar CRM and prospecting platforms.

  • Unlimited Earning Potential: We offer a competitive incentive plan with an uncapped commission structure that rewards outperformance.

With over 4,200 experts in 55 operational centres across 34 countries, our capabilities span the entire buying journey from customer acquisition, through engagement, to conversion and loyalty, driving multi-channel growth for world-leading brands.</p> <p>We work with some of the most exciting brands such as The Coca-Cola Company, EY, Bosch, Unilever, Ford, DFS, Mercedes-Benz, Johnson &amp; Johnson, Nestlé, Sainsbury’s, Selfridges, Shell and Tiffany &amp; Co. Our reputation is based on our people, and we believe we have some of the best in the business.</p> <p>As our business grows internationally, we’re looking for new people to join us on our journey to inspire and take a key role in shaping some of the best commerce solutions, services, and websites in the world. Working as a team, no problem is insurmountable; we share in our client’s successes and believe that anyone can show creative bravery no matter what their role is in the team.</p> <p>#LI-EMEA</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB"><span lang="EN-GB">We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</span></span></span></p> <p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB">WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. Begin to delegate tasks and share responsibility for outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Content Coordination:</strong>&nbsp;Manage the pipeline of social content across multiple sources (including UGC and influencers), matching client needs with a strategic approach, to coordinate content creation and curation ahead of publishing.</li> <li><strong>Presentation Skills:</strong>&nbsp;Present to senior clients and internal teams in a clear, concise, and persuasive manner, including new proposals, status updates, and performance reporting; all often of a highly complex nature. Respond spontaneously to issues or questions that arise.</li> <li><strong>Social Best Practice:</strong>&nbsp;Use a truly native and broad understanding of everything social (from LinkedIn to TikTok, from Stories to TopView ads) in conjunction with social strategy to guide and inspire clients and internal teams. Share this knowledge proactively with others.</li> <li><strong>Brand Guardianship:</strong>&nbsp;Understand and embody the needs of the brand, matched with social, and how the different aspects of the brand need to show up (from personal to business, and from more serious to more fun).</li> </ul> <p><strong>The ideal candidate will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a highly collaborative team player, capable of building strong relationships with clients, internal teams, and external partners.</li> <li>Be incredibly organised and able to reduce complexity, bringing it into an organised focus.</li> <li>Have a proactive attitude with excellent presentation and communication skills.</li> <li>Be comfortable working in a dynamic environment and managing multiple projects simultaneously.</li> <li>Be passionate about "what's next" in social, to stay ahead of the curve.</li> <li>Be able to set and manage expectations, anticipating next steps and taking action without direction.</li> <li>Be a proactive and results-oriented individual with a strong work ethic and a commitment to excellence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications &amp; Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have a proven track record of managing social media activity for major brands.</li> <li>Demonstrate a strong understanding of social media platforms, emerging trends, and evolving technologies.</li> <li>Have a proven ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.</li> <li>Have worked with cross-functional teams and managed multiple projects simultaneously.</li> <li>Experience working within an agency environment or across complex client ecosystems is highly beneficial, although not essential.</li> <li>A degree or equivalent experience will help us understand your background and point of view.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Sound like you? Then we'd love to talk to you about this super exciting opportunity!</p> <p><strong>What's in it for you?</strong></p> <p>Aside from a generous annual leave allowance and pension allowances, you will have access to a whole host of other benefits and activities such as:</p> <ul> <li>Life Assurance</li> <li>Permanent Health Insurance</li> <li>BUPA</li> <li>Flexible hybrid-working schedule</li> <li>Enhanced family friendly policies</li> <li>Well-being Programme</li> <li>Employee Assistance Support</li> <li>Cycle to Work Scheme</li> <li>Eye Care and Glasses Vouchers</li> <li>Season Ticket Loans</li> <li>WPP Discounts</li> </ul> <p>You will also have a clear long-term career development plan and access to our learning and development activities and online learning platforms.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity &amp; Inclusion</strong></p> <p>VML is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, colour, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical or mental disability. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who We Are</strong></h3> <p>VML, part of WPP, is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and human first, award-winning work for blue chip client partners including AstraZeneca, Colgate-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca-Cola Company, and Wendy's. The agency is recognized by the Forrester Wave™ Reports, as a Leader among Marketing Creative and Content Service Providers, Commerce Services, Global Digital Experience Services, Global Marketing Services and, most recently, Marketing Measurement &amp; Optimization. In addition, VML’s specialist health network, VML Health, is one of the world’s largest and most awarded health agencies. VML’s global network is powered by 26,000 talented people across 55+ markets, with principal offices in Kansas City, New York, Detroit, London, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Sydney.</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. title: Senior Social Commerce Strategist (Permanent)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who We Are</strong></h3> <p>VML, part of WPP, is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and human first, award-winning work for blue chip client partners including AstraZeneca, Colgate-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca-Cola Company, and Wendy's. The agency is recognized by the Forrester Wave™ Reports, as a Leader among Marketing Creative and Content Service Providers, Commerce Services, Global Digital Experience Services, Global Marketing Services and, most recently, Marketing Measurement &amp; Optimization. In addition, VML’s specialist health network, VML Health, is one of the world’s largest and most awarded health agencies. VML’s global network is powered by 26,000 talented people across 55+ markets, with principal offices in Kansas City, New York, Detroit, London, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Sydney.</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite&nbsp;cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel&nbsp;in a single company –&nbsp;powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open,&nbsp;to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit&nbsp;<u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="2714312b-312f-4651-9f88-d8a4e47547bc">WPP.com</a></u>.</p></div><h3>Senior Social Commerce - TikTok Shop Manager needed on a permanent basis to join our Global Social Commerce Team.</h3> <h3>The opportunity</h3> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive social media strategies focused on commerce that unify paid and organic efforts to drive measurable results for our clients. You will work closely with client editorial, creative, and marketing teams to craft overall strategic visions and platform-specific content strategies, bringing creative vision to life through exceptional content that resonates with target audiences and drives online shopper experiences.</p> <p>Essential to this role is understanding the social networks, how they drive engagement and growth for clients and being able to drive both strategy and execution for clients across all, in particular with a focus on TikTok shop.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>What you’ll be doing</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Leadership:</strong>&nbsp;Develop and implement comprehensive social media strategies that align with client business objectives and drive measurable results. This includes defining target audiences, setting KPIs, and identifying key opportunities for growth.</li> <li><strong>Paid &amp; Organic Integration:</strong>&nbsp;Develop strategies that seamlessly integrate paid and organic social media efforts to maximize reach, engagement, and conversion.</li> <li><strong>Content Strategy &amp; Development:</strong>&nbsp;Collaborate with client editorial, creative, and marketing teams to develop engaging and innovative content strategies that resonate with target audiences and drive online shopper experiences.</li> <li><strong>Platform Expertise:</strong>&nbsp;Maintain a deep understanding of social media platforms, best practices, and emerging trends, and leverage this knowledge to develop innovative and effective strategies.</li> <li><strong>Client Management:</strong>&nbsp;Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, acting as a trusted advisor and providing strategic guidance on social media best practices.</li> <li><strong>Brief Response &amp; Execution:</strong>&nbsp;Digest, interpret, and respond to briefs in a fast-paced environment, ensuring that strategies are aligned with client objectives and delivered on time and within budget.</li> <li><strong>Performance Analysis &amp; Reporting:</strong>&nbsp;Track and analyze social media performance, providing regular reports and insights to clients and internal stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Project Leadership:</strong>&nbsp;Lead social media projects from inception to completion, ensuring that they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards.</li> <li><strong>Presentation &amp; Communication:</strong>&nbsp;Confidently present strategic thinking and creative solutions to clients, including senior-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Innovation &amp; Thought Leadership:</strong>&nbsp;Stay abreast of the latest social media trends and technologies, and proactively identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration:</strong>&nbsp;Work closely with internal teams, including creative, media, and analytics, to ensure that social media strategies are integrated with overall marketing efforts.</li> <li><strong>Client Location Work:</strong>&nbsp;Willingness to work at client locations as needed.</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>What we want from you</h3> <ul> <li>Talented, enthusiastic, focused, and professional.</li> <li>Strong attention to detail with an understanding of design fundamentals.</li> <li>Positive and outgoing creative thinker, seeking pragmatic and creative solutions and seeing challenges as shining opportunities.</li> <li>Adaptable and thrives in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Passionate about inspiring outstanding online shopper experiences for consumers and brands, no matter what product, service, sector, device, or channel!</li> <li>Customer-first mindset with the maturity and initiative to keep clients happy.</li> <li>Experience working with social platforms, in particular Meta and TikTok Shop</li> <li>Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to understand and communicate complex concepts.</li> <li>Confident in recommending creative solutions to clients.</li> <li>Degree qualified, ideally in Marketing, Advertising, Digital Marketing, Communications, or Business (subject specific is not essential).</li> <li>Proven experience in digesting, interpreting, and responding to briefs in a high-paced environment.</li> <li>Hands-on experience in a social strategist role – either brand or agency side</li> <li>Highly consultative with a deep understanding of social media platforms, best practices, and innovation.</li> <li>Experience working with global brands, partnering with senior clients, and leading projects.</li> <li>Experience in the consumer packaged goods (CPG) or related industry (e.g., personal care, household products, food &amp; beverage) is highly desirable. This includes understanding the unique challenges and opportunities within this sector, such as navigating complex regulatory environments, managing brand reputation, and driving online sales through social commerce.</li> <li>Passionate about social media, digital, and commerce, and about the possibilities of revolutionizing commerce through social channels.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Attributes</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with social listening tools and analytics platforms (e.g., Sprinklr, Brandwatch, NetBase Quid, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics).</li> <li>Experience with social media advertising platforms (e.g., Facebook Ads Manager, Twitter Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager).</li> <li>Experience with influencer marketing and content creation.</li> <li>Strong understanding of SEO principles and best practices.</li> <li>Experience with A/B testing and optimization.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Strong organizational and time management skills.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and as part of a team.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>What we can offer you</h3> <p>Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.</p> <p><strong>Permanent only:</strong><br>We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.</p> <p>Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.</p> <p>We lead with&nbsp;<strong>Heart</strong>, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.<br>We empower your&nbsp;<strong>Brains&nbsp;</strong>for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.<br>And we champion&nbsp;<strong>Courage</strong>, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em><strong><span class="TextRun SCXW109799401 BCX0" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW109799401 BCX0">How we use AI in In addition, VML’s specialist health network, VML Health, is one of the world’s largest and most awarded health agencies. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who We Are</strong></h3> <p>VML, part of WPP, is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and human first, award-winning work for blue chip client partners including AstraZeneca, Colgate-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca-Cola Company, and Wendy's. The agency is recognized by the Forrester Wave™ Reports, as a Leader among Marketing Creative and Content Service Providers, Commerce Services, Global Digital Experience Services, Global Marketing Services and, most recently, Marketing Measurement &amp; Optimization. In addition, VML’s specialist health network, VML Health, is one of the world’s largest and most awarded health agencies. VML’s global network is powered by 26,000 talented people across 55+ markets, with principal offices in Kansas City, New York, Detroit, London, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Sydney.</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite&nbsp;cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel&nbsp;in a single company –&nbsp;powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open,&nbsp;to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit&nbsp;<u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="2714312b-312f-4651-9f88-d8a4e47547bc">WPP.com</a></u>.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Who we’re looking for:</strong></span></p> <p>VML is seeking a Data Planning Director to be a trusted partner to our clients, navigating their business, understanding their challenges and connecting across VML, as well as WPP at large, to ensure we are setup to deliver success with world-class services and solutions.</p> <p>This role is part of an integrated Data &amp; Analytics team across measurement &amp; reporting, predictive modelling, data strategy solutions, covering media, CX, CRM and more. The focus is to act as the glue between clients, WPP teams on all things data. As such, you will need to organise, motivate and inspire to connect all (data and non-data) disciplines in delivering success for our clients. Gravitas and strong collaboration are essential.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Team direction and oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct a team of data, technology and business consultants, analysts and engineers, overseeing client briefs and managing team workload.</li> <li>Direct and motivate the team to help them achieve their goals and deliver brilliant work for VML’s clients.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data &amp; Analytics leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as strategic partner and advisor, helping clients to leverage the power of data, martech, analytics and AI to achieve their goals and drive effectiveness and efficiency.</li> <li>Develop proposals and methodologies for <ul> <li>Data Planning; encompassing data-driven journey design, targeting personalisation, test and learn</li> <li>Analytics &amp; Data Science solutions; encompassing customer analytics (e.g. customer segmentation, predictive modelling), digital analytics (e.g. journey analysis, web/app, media analysis), business intelligence (e.g. dashboard reporting) and AI (e.g. conversational BI)</li> <li>Data &amp; Analytics consulting; encompassing data, marketing technology, AI and operations (process, skills, culture, business change etc.). Includes data, AI, martech and adtech transformation roadmaps, measurement frameworks and associated operating model development.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Inspire our clients and all of VML with thought-leadership and best practice.</li> <li>Work closely with our clients to help diagnose and solve their challenges, support their data &amp; AI vision, and make it happen.</li> <li>Drive client success and satisfaction in all you do.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Business Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>New business – be a data and analytics lead for pitches to deliver winning proposals and presentations.</li> <li>New &amp; Organic business – be relentless at bringing new ideas and opportunities to grow our existing clients and bring our data offer to clients who work with us in other disciplines.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>What you’ll need:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Exceptional experience leading across data and analytics in a consulting/agency environment, setting up teams and operating models with clients</li> <li>A belief in the value of data-driven marketing &amp; VML is celebrated for its innovative and human first, award-winning work for blue chip client partners including AstraZeneca, Colgate-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca-Cola Company, and Wendy's. The agency is recognized by the Forrester Wave™ Reports, as a Leader among Marketing Creative and Content Service Providers, Commerce Services, Global Digital Experience Services, Global Marketing Services and, most recently, Marketing Measurement &amp; Optimization. In addition, VML’s specialist health network, VML Health, is one of the world’s largest and most awarded health agencies. VML’s global network is powered by 26,000 talented people across 55+ markets, with principal offices in Kansas City, New York, Detroit, London, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Sydney.</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span data-teams="true">Pantheon has been at the forefront of private markets investing for more than 40 years, earning a reputation for an innovative approach to investing in secondaries, co-investments, and primary fund investments, as well as capital formation across commingled funds, evergreen vehicles and customized solutions. Our specialist investment capabilities span multiple strategies across private equity, infrastructure and real assets, and private credit. Through our collaborative and committed culture, we find new ways to solve complex problems together and deliver innovative investment opportunities across private markets. Pantheon currently manages approximately $82.3 billion in AUM across all its strategies, serving more than 750 institutional and 638 private wealth clients worldwide</span></p> <p>For further details please visit <a href="http://www.pantheon.com">www.pantheon.com</a></p></div><p><strong>Purpose of the Position&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The overall purpose of my role at Pantheon is to provide in-house legal advice and support to the business by assisting with the establishment and fundraising of Pantheon funds and separate account programmes, assisting with general corporate group, regulatory and compliance matters and assisting the various investment team divisions with investment related work.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>Fund Raising:</em></p> <ul> <li>Establishing Pantheon funds and assisting in their fundraising; advising on fund structure; drafting / reviewing fund documentation (LPAs, PPMs, side letters, etc.); co-ordinating investor closings; fund maintenance work</li> <li>Assisting with segregated account programmes – drafting / reviewing / negotiating term sheets, investment management agreements and segregated limited partnership agreements</li> <li>Coordinating with internal marketing and investor relations teams, independent boards of directors, external counsel and administrators in respect of the launch, marketing/fundraising and maintenance of the Pantheon funds</li> <li>Preparing and maintaining various Pantheon fund/client checklists</li> </ul> <p><em>Corporate and Regulatory:</em></p> <ul> <li>Working alongside the Compliance team on issues connected with all UK/European regulatory aspects of Pantheon’s business (e.g. AIFMD and related issues around filings and marketing passports); keeping up to date on new European legislation relevant to fund structuring and management</li> <li>Identification, interpretation and application of applicable UK laws, rules and regulations</li> <li>Drafting / reviewing / negotiating a wide range of contracts (including commercial agreements, contracts with service providers, and statements of work)</li> <li>Advising staff of legal and regulatory requirements/boundaries/risks</li> <li>Supervising and educating external counsels on Pantheon practices</li> <li>Liaising with applicable regulatory authorities</li> <li>Attending to other general Pantheon group corporate matters</li> </ul> <p><em>Investment Work:</em></p> <ul> <li>Assisting the various investment team divisions (primary, secondary, co-investment, infrastructure) in relation to investment transactions; assisting with queries on NDAs, fund / transaction terms</li> <li>Preparing and maintaining various Pantheon investment checklists</li> </ul> <p><strong>Knowledge and Experience Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Good ‘A’ Level (or equivalent)</li> <li>Either an undergraduate Law degree, or any undergraduate degree plus a Graduate Diploma in Law</li> <li>Qualified as a Solicitor in England &amp; Wales.</li> <li>English qualified solicitors must maintain a practising certificate. Part of maintaining a practising certificate is to undertake regular learning and development to ensure that skills and knowledge remain up to date. An annual declaration that this has been done must be made to the Solicitors Regulatory Authority.&nbsp;</li> <li>Must have relevant post-qualification experience obtained in a top 10 (or equivalent) law firm or in-house position</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>This job description is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. You may be required to perform other job-related duties as reasonably requested by your manager.</strong></p> <p><strong>Pantheon is an Equal Opportunities employer, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't perfectly align we'd still encourage you to apply.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data Engineer (Databricks / Snowflake)
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <div id="message-list_1783615196.642129"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div>Alpha Financial Markets Consulting (Alpha) is a leading global consultancy to the financial services industry. We are a boutique management consulting firm that offers the world’s top industry players a competitive edge through our expertise and industry insight. Our team is of a uniquely high calibre and works across regulated financial markets, bringing deep expertise in insurance, alternative asset markets — including private equity, private credit, infrastructure and real estate — and other specialised financial sectors. This focus enables us to bring relevant, hands-on experience to our clients’ most important challenges.&nbsp; We have our headquarters located the United Kingdom, as well as offices in major global financial centres across the United States, France, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Switzerland, and Asia.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <h1>About the role</h1> <p>Our senior data engineers are hands-on leaders of consultants and client teams, building data platforms for clients in regulated financial services – private equity, real estate, fund administration, and specialist insurance. You'll work directly with client stakeholders, from engineering leads to CTOs, delivering production pipelines on Databricks or Snowflake (strong experience in one is sufficient). This is a hands-on build role with client exposure. You'll write code, review architecture decisions, lead junior engineers and explain trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.</p> <h1>What you'll do</h1> <ul> <li>Lead and mentor junior engineers on your delivery workstream, reviewing their code and data model decisions</li> <li>Build reliable ingestion pipelines that move client data from source systems into the platform efficiently and securely</li> <li>Design data models – Data Vault 2.0, Kimball Dimensional etc. that survive audit and give the business one trusted version of the numbers</li> <li>Build pipelines to agreed SLAs and own their reliability in production</li> <li>Work with domain SMEs to translate business logic into pipeline logic that produces correct numbers</li> <li>Bring LLM-based processing into pipelines where it fits, document parsing, entity extraction, unstructured data classification, alongside deterministic logic</li> <li>Build AI-powered business solutions on the platform, agents, search, and applied use cases on Mosaic AI or Cortex, that solve a client problem with trusted data rather than demo a capability</li> <li>Support pre-sales by sizing effort and cost for prospective engagements, contribute to delivery plans, and present technical approach to prospective clients</li> </ul> <h1>What you'll bring</h1> <ul> <li>4+ years in data engineering, with at least 2 years on Databricks <strong>or</strong> Snowflake in production (one platform is sufficient)</li> <li>Strong SQL and Python; comfort with PySpark or Snowpark</li> <li>Strong experience with at least one cloud vendor, Azure, AWS, or GCP, including core services beyond the data platform itself (networking, IAM, storage)</li> <li>Working knowledge of dimensional modelling (Kimball) and/or Data Vault 2.0</li> <li>Comfortable presenting technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders</li> <li>Track record of setting engineering standards and reviewing others' code for quality, not just correctness</li> <li>Comfortable leading or mentoring junior engineers on a delivery team, and taking ownership of technical decisions</li> </ul> <h1>Additional experience we’d value</h1> <ul> <li>Snowflake or Databricks certifications</li> <li>Familiarity with private markets data (fund administration, private equity/real estate, secondaries) or London Market insurance</li> <li>Experience with supporting tooling such as IaC; Transformation (dbt); DevOps; Data Quality; Data Modelling; Data Glossary/Governance; iPaaS/ELT, Orchestration</li> <li>Some exposure to regulated environments – financial services, insurance, or similarly audited sectors – and awareness of relevant regulatory frameworks including FCA SYSC, DORA, and MiFID II</li> </ul> <h1>What the engagement looks like</h1> <p>You'll work closely with client teams, alongside their internal engineers and Alpha consultants in a regulated environment where change control, data lineage and documentation matter. You'll write code, typically tackling the most complex challenges, review code and data model decisions across the team, and take responsibility for a delivery workstream – planning it, running it, and leading the junior engineers working on it.</p> <h1>What We Offer</h1> <ul> <li>Competitive base salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Annual performance bonus tied to individual and company outcomes.</li> <li>Comprehensive benefits package including private medical insurance, life assurance, and income protection.</li> <li>Hybrid working model with flexible arrangements to support work-life balance.</li> <li>Generous pension scheme with enhanced employer contributions.</li> <li>Continuous learning budget and access to industry conferences, certifications, and training programmes.</li> <li>25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with option to buy additional days.</li> <li>Employee assistance programme and wellbeing support.</li> </ul> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>Salesforce Solution Architect (Client &amp; Digital) – Asset &amp; Wealth Management</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Who we are</strong></p> <p>Alpha Financial Markets Consulting (Alpha) is the leading consultancy to the asset and wealth management industry. Over the past 20 years, we have grown to become a team of 1,500 industry experts working across all of the major financial centres globally, partnering with 80 of the top 100 managers by AUM, and all of the top 20. We are proud that many of our team have established long and fulfilling careers with us, with many having stayed for well over a decade, playing central roles in building the business that we are today.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We hope that you will join us to shape the next chapter of our growth story.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The opportunity:</strong></p> <p>Alpha’s Client &amp; Digital practice partners with leading managers to address their most strategic priorities. These typically relate to client experience, growth, scalability and M&amp;A. Given our unique combination of global scale and industry focus, we are able to provide clients with deep insight and trusted delivery, often leveraging proprietary IP and accelerators.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Over the past 12 months, Alpha’s Client &amp; Digital practice has experienced significant growth. We are therefore seeking to selectively bolster our team with individuals who share our passion for using technology to address our industry’s most important challenges.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>You'll be working directly with senior business and technology stakeholders to translate ambiguous strategic challenges into architectures that actually get built and actually work – and you'll have real influence over the tools, accelerators, and standards the wider practice uses to do it.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Solve real business problems.</strong> Partner directly with client stakeholders across Marketing, Sales and Service to understand what's broken – then design and deliver the Salesforce-centric architecture that fixes it.</li> <li><strong>Own solution design end-to-end.</strong> Lead the architecture of Sales, Marketing &amp; Service solutions that extend across and beyond the core Salesforce ecosystem.</li> <li><strong>Translate strategy into shipped technology.</strong> Turn business need into architectures and implementation plans that delivery teams can build.</li> <li><strong>Take on the most complex development.</strong> Operate as Lead Developer on implementations, personally tackling the most complex elements</li> <li><strong>Create designs that outlast the engagement.</strong> Contribute to the accelerators, reusable assets and best practices that define how Alpha's Client &amp; Digital practice delivers value into the future – your fingerprints stay on the practice.</li> <li><strong>Shape the next generation.</strong> Mentor and coach consultants and architects coming up behind you, working alongside some of the most experienced people in the field.</li> <li><strong>Stay at the front of the curve.</strong> Get hands-on with the platforms clients are betting their futures on – AgentForce, Data 360, CRM Analytics – before most of the market has caught up.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>What you bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years</strong> of consulting experience in Salesforce architecture, solution design and implementation – ideally within Financial Services.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on expertise</strong> in Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC), with real fluency across the wider Salesforce ecosystem.</li> <li><strong>Up-to-date Salesforce development skills</strong>: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, Salesforce APIs, Flow Builder.</li> <li><strong>Integration know-how</strong>: APIs, ELT/ETL, and iPaaS such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, ADF.</li> <li><strong>CI/CD experience</strong> designing and implementing SDLC pipelines with Salesforce-specific tools eg Copado, Gearset and gneric platforms eg eg Azure DevOps, Github/Jenkins</li> <li><strong>Range</strong>: you've led as both hands-on architect/developer <em>and</em> as a development team lead – you can go deep or go wide depending on what the engagement needs.</li> <li><strong>Communication that lands</strong> – with clients, with delivery teams, and with your own team.</li> <li><strong>A track record of building teams</strong>, not just projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Nice to have (not deal-breakers):</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in Asset or Wealth Management specifically.</li> <li>Pre-sales exposure.</li> <li>You've built or extended technical accelerators before, not just used them.</li> <li>Curiosity beyond Salesforce — Sales, Marketing and Service platforms in the broader ecosystem.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>People who thrive here:</strong></p> <p>You're someone who wants to understand <em>why</em> a problem matters before you design the solution. You're ambitious about your own growth, but you'd rather build something well with a strong team than build it alone. You're comfortable with ambiguity and fast-moving environments, and you hold your own work to a high bar because you take quality personally. You want a platform where good ideas move fast — because you'll help create them</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Relevant Salesforce Products:<br><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Financial Services Cloud</li> <li>AgentForce</li> <li>Data360</li> <li>Experience Cloud</li> <li>Marketing Cloud and Account Engagement</li> <li>CRM Analytics</li> <li>Slack MCP</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Data Engineer (Databricks / Snowflake)
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <div id="message-list_1783615196.642129"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div>Alpha Financial Markets Consulting (Alpha) is a leading global consultancy to the financial services industry. We are a boutique management consulting firm that offers the world’s top industry players a competitive edge through our expertise and industry insight. Our team is of a uniquely high calibre and works across regulated financial markets, bringing deep expertise in insurance, alternative asset markets — including private equity, private credit, infrastructure and real estate — and other specialised financial sectors. This focus enables us to bring relevant, hands-on experience to our clients’ most important challenges.&nbsp; We have our headquarters located the United Kingdom, as well as offices in major global financial centres across the United States, France, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Switzerland, and Asia.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <h1>About the role</h1> <p>We’re looking for a Data Engineer with 2+ years’ experience to join our growing data engineering capability. This role is focused on client delivery. You’ll work closely with client teams, alongside their internal engineers and Alpha consultants, to build and support modern data platforms in regulated financial services environments. The work is hands-on and delivery-focused: building pipelines, developing data models, and helping turn business requirements into trusted, production-ready data solutions.</p> <p>This is a strong opportunity for an engineer who wants more than just pipeline delivery. You’ll work directly with clients, solve real platform and data problems, and build experience across a range of delivery challenges in complex regulated environments.</p> <h1>What you'll do</h1> <ul> <li>Build reliable ingestion pipelines that move client data from source systems into the platform efficiently and securely</li> <li>Develop data pipelines to agreed SLAs, with a focus on reliability in production</li> <li>Work with domain SMEs and delivery teams to translate business logic into pipeline logic that produces accurate, trusted outputs Senior Data Engineer.docx</li> <li>Design data models, including Data Vault 2.0 and Kimball dimensional models, that support auditability and trusted reporting</li> <li>Support testing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and documentation across the delivery lifecycle</li> <li>Contribute to engineering standards and delivery best practices as part of a wider team</li> <li>Work with the team to implement LLM-based processing in pipelines where appropriate, alongside deterministic logic</li> <li>Work on delivery teams building AI-enabled solutions on the platform, helping to apply trusted data to real client problems</li> <li>Share learnings from delivery work and contribute to internal assets, tooling, and practices over time.</li> </ul> <h1>What you'll bring</h1> <ul> <li>2+ years in data engineering, including production experience with Databricks <strong>or</strong> Snowflake (one platform is sufficient)</li> <li>Strong SQL and Python; comfort with PySpark or Snowpark</li> <li>Experience with at least one cloud vendor, Azure, AWS, or GCP, including familiarity with core services beyond the data platform itself (networking, IAM, storage)</li> <li>Working knowledge of dimensional modelling (Kimball) and/or Data Vault 2.0</li> <li>Strong attention to quality, documentation, and delivery discipline</li> </ul> <h1>Additional experience we’d value</h1> <ul> <li>Snowflake or Databricks certifications</li> <li>Familiarity with private markets data (fund administration, private equity/real estate, secondaries) or London Market insurance</li> <li>Experience with some supporting tooling across areas such as infrastructure-as-code, transformation, DevOps, data quality, governance, or orchestration would be beneficial.</li> <li>Exposure to regulated environments such as financial services, insurance, or similarly audited sectors would be beneficial.</li> </ul> <h1>What the engagement looks like</h1> <p>You'll work within client teams, alongside their internal engineers and Alpha consultants in a regulated environment where change control, data lineage and documentation matter. Expect a mix of independent build work and collaborative delivery, with regular touchpoints against a delivery plan.</p> <h1>What We Offer</h1> <ul> <li>Competitive base salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Annual performance bonus tied to individual and company outcomes.</li> <li>Comprehensive benefits package including private medical insurance, life assurance, and income protection.</li> <li>Hybrid working model with flexible arrangements to support work-life balance.</li> <li>Generous pension scheme with enhanced employer contributions.</li> <li>Continuous learning budget and access to industry conferences, certifications, and training programmes.</li> <li>25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with option to buy additional days.</li> <li>Employee assistance programme and wellbeing support.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
